Thought: I need to determine which option is not provided in a Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS). Let me analyze each option:

A. Accidental release measures - This is a standard section in an MSDS that provides procedures for cleaning up spills and leaks.
B. Composition/information on ingredients - This is a standard section in an MSDS that lists the hazardous ingredients.
C. First aid measures - This is a standard section in an MSDS that provides instructions for treating exposure.
D. Handling and storage information - This is a standard section in an MSDS that provides guidelines for safe handling and storage.
E. Medicine to be taken by the effected person if exposed to the chemical - MSDS typically provides first aid measures but does not prescribe specific medications. This is not a standard section in an MSDS.

Based on my knowledge of MSDS contents, option E is not typically provided in an MSDS. MSDS documents provide emergency and first aid procedures but do not specifically prescribe medicines, as that would be the role of medical professionals.
